relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Besides, VEGF and their endothelial tyrosine kinase receptors are involved in vasculogenesis, angiogenesis, and lymphangiogenesis, promoting the angiogenic pathway through signaling with VEGFR-2.

key_findings: Child with cystic angiomatosis had elevated serum VEGF (287.26 pg/ml) and ALP; exome sequencing found variants in BRIP1, CHEK2, GRM4, MUC16.
